title: Building the Foundation for a Scalable India Technology Center
summary: Discover how Concentrix launched a fully operational India technology center in 90 days through a scalable Build-Operate-Transfer approach.
body_markdown:
As part of its expansion strategy, the bank sought to establish a fully operational software development center in a Tier-2 Indian city. The initiative required rapid deployment while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, implementation of secure and scalable infrastructure, and access to highly skilled engineering talent.


The bank needed a trusted partner capable of managing the end-to-end setup, from regulatory approvals and infrastructure readiness to talent acquisition, operational governance, and seamless transition of ownership.
